title: Complete Market Intel, Pre-Sale, Airdrop & All UI-Only Sections

requirements.summary: Implement passcode lock for MarketIntelPage with sessionStorage persistence
acceptanceCriteria: Entering 'BO2420075112009BP' unlocks the page
Entering any other string shows an error and keeps the page locked
Unlock state persists in sessionStorage across soft navigations

file_operations.description: Add passcode lock UI with input form and 'Unlock' button before the existing authenticated content. On correct passcode 'BO2420075112009BP', set sessionStorage key 'marketIntelUnlocked' to 'true' and update component state. On incorrect passcode, display clear error message. Check sessionStorage on mount to restore unlocked state. Wrap the passcode form in a styled glass-card with gold borders and center the lock icon, title, and input field.

requirements.summary: Display fully functional trading signals dashboard in MarketIntelPage after unlock
acceptanceCriteria: Time frame and asset selectors are visible and functional after unlock
Signal (BUY/SELL/HOLD) updates when asset or timeframe changes
RSI, MACD, and MA values are displayed
Data comes from public CoinGecko API with no placeholder values

file_operations.description: Extend the hook to accept asset (string) and timeframe (string) parameters. Map timeframe to CoinGecko days parameter (1H->1, 4H->2, 1D->7, 1W->30). Support at least BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP as selectable assets. Return computed RSI, MACD, MA crossover indicators, BUY/SELL/HOLD signal, confidence score, and live price for the selected asset and timeframe.

After the passcode unlock guard, add UI for: (1) a timeframe selector (1H/4H/1D/1W) using tabs or radio buttons, (2) an asset dropdown for BTC/ETH/BNB/SOL/XRP, (3) a large signal card showing BUY/SELL/HOLD with confidence percentage using the extended useMarketIntelLive hook with selected asset and timeframe, (4) a live price ticker card for the selected asset, (5) three indicator cards displaying RSI value, MACD histogram, and MA trend direction. Use the existing glass-card styling with gold accents. Display loading skeletons and error states with retry buttons.

requirements.summary: Fully implement Pre-Sale tab in AcquisitionPage with countdown timer and WhatsApp redirect
acceptanceCriteria: Countdown timer ticks in real time while locked
Form is hidden while timer is running
Form is revealed when unlocked flag is true
Submission opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message containing all form fields
Partial form data survives page refresh via sessionStorage

file_operations.description: In the Pre-Sale tab section: (1) Use useCountdownTimer('presale') to fetch the timer end and display a live countdown in large segmented digit blocks (DD:HH:MM:SS) with gold borders. (2) While countdown is running (unlocked flag false), render a locked state with lock icon, timer prominently centered, and explanatory text 'Pre-Sale opens Q1 2027'. (3) When unlocked flag is true, hide the countdown and reveal the Pre-Sale registration form collecting: full name, email, phone number, wallet address, amount to invest, country. (4) On form submission, use buildWhatsAppMessage from frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts to construct a pre-filled message with all field values and openWhatsAppRedirect to open WhatsApp with REDIRECT_CONFIG's number. (5) Persist partial form data in sessionStorage under key 'presaleFormDraft' and restore on mount. Use glass-card styling with gold accents throughout.

requirements.summary: Fully implement Airdrop tab in AcquisitionPage with countdown timer and WhatsApp redirect
acceptanceCriteria: Countdown timer ticks in real time while locked
Airdrop form is hidden until timer expires
Submission redirects to WhatsApp with pre-filled airdrop registration message
Partial form data survives page refresh via sessionStorage

file_operations.description: In the Airdrop tab section: (1) Use useCountdownTimer('airdrop') to fetch the timer end and display a live countdown in large segmented digit blocks (DD:HH:MM:SS) with gold borders. (2) While countdown is running (unlocked flag false), render a locked state with lock icon, timer prominently centered, and explanatory text 'Airdrop opens Q1 2029'. (3) When unlocked flag is true, hide the countdown and reveal the Airdrop registration form collecting: full name, email, wallet address, country, referral code (optional). (4) On form submission, use buildWhatsAppMessage and openWhatsAppRedirect from frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts with all field values. (5) Persist partial form data in sessionStorage under key 'airdropFormDraft' and restore on mount. Use glass-card styling with gold accents.

requirements.summary: Complete all empty/placeholder frontend section and page components with full implementations
acceptanceCriteria: FormsSection renders presale and airdrop countdown/form panels
HeroSection renders with RBS logo, tagline, and working CTA buttons
OracleSection renders live market data from CoinGecko
WhitepaperSection renders chapter teasers with link to WhitepaperPage
DeveloperBlogPage and DeveloperToolsPage each render at least 3 content cards

file_operations.description: Implement a section rendering both Pre-Sale and Airdrop panels side-by-side (or stacked on mobile). Each panel includes a countdown timer using useCountdownTimer hook and a brief description. Link each panel to the respective tab on AcquisitionPage. Use glass-card styling with gold borders and the RBS logo asset from frontend/public/assets/generated/rbs-logo-transparent.dim_200x200.png. Apply smoky section transition animation.

Implement an animated hero section with: (1) RBS logo using frontend/public/assets/generated/rbs-logo-hero-metallic.dim_400x400.png centered at top, (2) a bold tagline 'RBS Institutional Hub - Advanced DeFi Intelligence & Trading Signals', (3) two primary CTA buttons: 'Join Pre-Sale' linking to AcquisitionPage (presale tab) and 'Read Whitepaper' linking to WhitepaperPage. Use gold gradient buttons and apply parallax scrolling effect via useParallax hook. Background should use frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.

Implement a live oracle-style data feed section displaying real-time global crypto market metrics fetched via useRealWorldAnalytics hook: total market cap, BTC dominance, ETH dominance, 24h volume, and active cryptocurrencies count. Render these as animated metric cards in a grid layout with glass-card styling and gold accents. Show loading skeletons and error states with retry button. Apply smoky section transition animation.

Implement a whitepaper teaser section with: (1) a section title 'Explore the RBS Whitepaper', (2) a grid of 4-6 chapter highlight cards showing chapter titles (e.g., 'Introduction', 'Tokenomics', 'Technology', 'Governance', 'Roadmap', 'Security') with brief descriptions and chapter icons, (3) a prominent CTA button 'Read Full Whitepaper' linking to WhitepaperPage. Use glass-card styling with gold borders and apply smoky section transition animation.

Implement a developer blog page with at least 3 blog post cards. Each card includes: post title (e.g., 'Building on ICP: Best Practices', 'Integrating RBS Oracles', 'Smart Contract Security Guide'), publication date, author, excerpt, and a 'Read More' link. Use glass-card styling with gold borders and apply fade-in animations on scroll. Include a page header with title 'Developer Blog' and subtitle 'Insights & Tutorials for RBS Builders'.

Implement a developer tools page with at least 3 tool/resource cards. Each card includes: tool name (e.g., 'RBS SDK', 'API Documentation', 'Smart Contract Templates'), description, key features list, and external link or download button. Use glass-card styling with gold borders and apply fade-in animations on scroll. Include a page header with title 'Developer Tools' and subtitle 'Resources & SDKs for Building on RBS'.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix all broken/incomplete functionality across frontend pages
acceptanceCriteria: useCountdownTimer displays 00:00:00:00 when expired without throwing errors
Unauthenticated users on LivePricePage see a clear login prompt
Unauthenticated users on AlertsCenterPage see a clear login prompt
AdvancedAnalyticsPage shows example symbols and handles empty input gracefully
AISentimentPage shows skeleton loader and retry button on error
Community voting join/vote/create flow provides visible feedback on success and failure

file_operations.description: Fix the hook to handle timer expiration gracefully: when the remaining time reaches zero or becomes negative, return formatted values '00:00:00:00' and set unlocked flag to true instead of throwing errors or returning invalid states. Ensure the timer stops ticking once expired and does not show negative values.

Add an authentication guard at the top of the component. If the user is not authenticated (check via useInternetIdentity), render a styled login prompt screen using glass-card with lock icon, title 'Authentication Required', subtitle 'Please log in with Internet Identity to view live prices', and a visible 'Login' button that triggers the login flow. Only render the live price dashboard after authentication.

Add an authentication guard at the top of the component. If the user is not authenticated (check via useInternetIdentity), render a styled login prompt screen using glass-card with lock icon, title 'Authentication Required', subtitle 'Please log in with Internet Identity to manage alerts', and a visible 'Login' button that triggers the login flow. Only render the alerts dashboard after authentication.

Handle empty search input gracefully: when the search input is empty or whitespace-only, display a placeholder state with example symbol hints (e.g., 'Try searching: BTC, ETH, SOL') and a glass-card showing popular symbols as clickable suggestion chips. Prevent API calls until a valid symbol is entered. Show clear error messages for invalid symbols.

Add a proper loading skeleton state while news data is fetching from useCryptoNews hook: display 5-6 animated skeleton cards in the news grid with gold-toned shimmer. On error, show a glass-card with error icon, error message, and a prominent 'Retry' button that refetches data. Ensure the 12-hour cache countdown timer is visible and updates in real-time.

Ensure the poll join, vote, and create flows provide clear user feedback: (1) On successful poll join, show a success toast message 'Successfully joined poll!'. (2) On successful vote submission, show 'Vote recorded!' toast and refresh poll data. (3) On successful poll creation, show 'Poll created!' toast and navigate to the new poll. (4) On errors (invalid code, already voted, passcode incorrect), show inline error messages or error toasts with specific failure reasons. Use glass-card styling for all feedback elements.

requirements.summary: Apply consistent gold/dark theme visual design system across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use glass-card style with gold border accents
Countdown timers display as large segmented digit blocks
Locked screens all show a lock icon with consistent title/subtitle layout
Loading skeletons are gold-toned and animated
No page uses default unstyled HTML or off-theme colors

file_operations.description: Ensure all cards and containers use the glass-card class with gold border accents from frontend/src/index.css. Countdown timer digits must be displayed as large, bold segmented blocks with gold borders. Locked state screen must show a prominent lock icon (use Lucide Lock icon), title, and subtitle in the established theme. Loading states must use animated gold-toned skeletons. Verify all text uses Inter/Poppins typography scale.

Audit all UI elements: ensure tabs, form inputs, buttons, and countdown timers use glass-card styling with gold accents. Countdown timers must display as large segmented digit blocks with gold borders. Locked state screens for both Pre-Sale and Airdrop tabs must show lock icon, consistent title/subtitle layout. All loading states use gold-toned animated skeletons. Primary buttons use gold gradient.

Ensure all price cards use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading skeletons must be gold-toned and animated. The authentication prompt screen must use glass-card with lock icon and consistent title/subtitle layout. Verify typography consistency using Inter/Poppins scale.

Ensure all alert cards and panels use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading skeletons must be gold-toned and animated. The authentication prompt screen must use glass-card with lock icon and consistent title/subtitle layout. All buttons use gold gradient for primary actions.

Ensure all metric cards use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading skeletons for analytics data must be gold-toned and animated. Placeholder state with symbol hints must use glass-card. Verify all typography uses Inter/Poppins scale.

Ensure all news article cards use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading skeletons must be gold-toned and animated with shimmer effect. Error state card must use glass-card with consistent styling. Countdown timer for cache expiry must be styled with gold accents.

Ensure all poll cards, voting panels, and form elements use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading states must use gold-toned animated skeletons. Success and error feedback toasts/messages must follow the gold/dark theme. All primary buttons use gold gradient.

Ensure all indicator cards and sentiment display use glass-card styling with gold border accents. Loading skeletons must be gold-toned and animated. Verify all typography uses Inter/Poppins scale and that the overall market status indicator is prominent with gold highlights.

requirements.summary: Integrate real public API data for all sections showing placeholder or static data
acceptanceCriteria: InsightsPage shows live global market cap from CoinGecko
MarketPulsePage shows live BTC RSI and MACD computed from real data
AISentimentPage shows real news from CryptoPanic with sentiment labels
All API error states are handled with retry buttons and user-friendly messages

file_operations.description: Ensure the page uses useRealWorldAnalytics hook to fetch live global market data from CoinGecko public /global endpoint. Display metrics: total market cap, BTC dominance, ETH dominance, 24h volume, and active cryptocurrencies count. Remove any hardcoded or placeholder values. Implement error handling with retry button and user-friendly error messages in glass-card style. Show loading skeletons while fetching.

Ensure the page uses useMarketPulse hook to fetch live BTC price history and compute RSI and MACD from real CoinGecko OHLC data. Display computed RSI value, MACD histogram, current BTC price, and 24h change. Remove any hardcoded or placeholder values. Implement error handling with retry button and user-friendly error messages in glass-card style. Show loading skeletons while fetching.

Ensure the page uses useCryptoNews hook to fetch real news articles from CryptoPanic public API. Display articles with sentiment labels (positive/negative/neutral) derived from vote counts. Remove any static or placeholder news data. Implement rate limiting error handling with clear error messages and retry button. Show loading skeletons while fetching. Display the 12-hour cache countdown timer.

Verify the hook fetches from CoinGecko public /global endpoint (no authentication required) with proper error handling. Ensure the returned data includes: total_market_cap.usd, market_cap_percentage.btc, market_cap_percentage.eth, total_volume.usd, and active_cryptocurrencies. Handle API rate limiting gracefully with exponential backoff and clear error states.

Verify the hook fetches Bitcoin 30-day OHLC data and current price from CoinGecko public API (no authentication required). Ensure RSI and MACD are computed from real price data. Handle API errors and rate limiting gracefully with clear error states and retry capability.

Verify the hook fetches from CryptoPanic public API (no authentication required) and derives sentiment from vote counts. Ensure the 12-hour cache mechanism works correctly. Handle API errors and rate limiting gracefully with clear error states and retry capability.
